cards.text: Jesus has His twelve disciples, and now He's sending them out with instructions. No map, no group chat, just Jesus telling them exactly how this trip works.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus sends the twelve into the towns of the Samaritans.

cards.text: So no road of the Gentiles and no Samaritan towns. Jesus sends them to the lost sheep of Israel instead, and as they go, they preach one message: "The kingdom of heaven is near."

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells the twelve to raise the dead.

cards.text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. MY to-do list says check the oven, and THEIRS says raise the dead.

cards.question: Jesus tells the twelve to heal the sick and drive out demons. He says they should give the same way they received: ___.

cards.text: Now packing, and Jesus says no gold, no silver, no copper in their belts. That's a road trip where somebody says "let's split the gas" and the whole car goes QUIET.

cards.question: Jesus keeps going down the packing list. What else does He tell the twelve to leave behind?

cards.text: No second tunic, no bag, no sandals, no staff. I live on a planet built for ONE bakery, and I still pack three aprons to walk to the oven.

cards.question: No money, no bag, no spare tunic. Why does Jesus say the twelve can travel this light?

answers.text: A worker deserves to be provided for
The towns are close to each other
The trip will only take a day

cards.text: So where do they sleep? Jesus says in whatever town or village they enter, find out who is worthy there.

cards.question: Once they find that worthy person, Jesus tells the twelve to ___ at his house until they move on.

cards.text: Walking in, they greet the people who live there. If the home is worthy, Jesus says to let their peace rest on it.

cards.question: True or false: if the home isn't worthy, Jesus says the twelve's peace still rests on it.

cards.text: If the home isn't worthy, that peace returns to them. And some people won't welcome them or listen to their words.

cards.question: When a home or town won't welcome the twelve, what does Jesus tell them to do as they leave?

answers.text: Shake the dust off their feet
Sing a psalm at the gate

cards.text: Shake off the dust. I spent YEARS under dust in a junk drawer, and NOBODY told me that was an option.

cards.question: On the day of judgment, Jesus says two cities will have it more bearable than a town that won't welcome the twelve. Which two?

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the twelve He's sending them out like sheep among wolves. That's a cookie walking into the break room at three in the afternoon.
So Jesus says be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves. Minty would frame this verse and hang it over every oven I own.

cards.question: Shrewd as snakes and innocent as doves. What is Jesus asking the twelve to be?

answers.text: Sharp and pure at the same time
Bold and ready to fight back

cards.text: But Jesus warns them to beware of men. They'll hand the twelve over to their councils.

cards.question: Jesus says people will flog the twelve in their ___.

cards.text: And it goes all the way up. On account of Jesus, they'll be brought before governors and kings.

cards.question: The twelve are standing before governors and kings. What does Jesus say they'll be there as?

answers.text: Witnesses to them and the Gentiles

cards.text: When they're handed over, Jesus says don't worry about how to respond or what to say. Friend, I rehearse what I'm gonna say to the OVEN, and the oven doesn't even talk back.

cards.question: No speech prepared. What does Jesus promise the twelve for that hour?

answers.text: They will be given what to say
A friend will speak for them

cards.question: Jesus says it won't really be the twelve talking. It will be the ___ of their Father speaking through them.

cards.text: Then it gets heavy. Jesus says brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child, and children will rise against their parents.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the twelve will be hated by everyone because of His name.
Hated by everyone. But who does Jesus say will be saved?

answers.text: The one who perseveres to the end
The one who stays out of sight
The one who wins every argument

cards.text: Then Jesus gets practical about towns that persecute them. And remember, these twelve have a LOT of towns in Israel to reach.

cards.question: True or false: when one town persecutes them, Jesus tells the twelve to stay and stand their ground there.

cards.text: Flee to the next town. Then Jesus says, "Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes."

cards.question: Jesus says a disciple is not above his ___, nor a servant above his master.

cards.text: It's enough for a disciple to be like his teacher. And if the head of the house has been called Beelzebul...

cards.question: If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, what does Jesus say about the members of his household?

answers.text: They will get it even more

cards.text: And we'll pause right there, friend. Grab a fresh apron, because Jesus isn't done talking and this teaching keeps going.
